programs.title: The Wild Sides
programs.desc: The creators of the three-part series follow the fate of several families of wild animals living in the Mashatu reserve in Botswana.The production was created over two years and presents the fate of four species.Around the bed of the dried river there are a pride of lions, elephants, a leopard, jackals with offspring, and playful baboons.Every day, these creatures fight to survive and raise their offspring in difficult conditions, and their fates are inextricably linked.Macquele the leopard is a single mother who must deal with the presence of hyenas, lions and jackals, as well as a troop of baboons giving her away her position every time she hunts.A herd of elephants led by Ukwethemba searches for food and water, covering long distances.For the young Abancane elephant, life on the move is not easy.Jackals are monogamous.The male and female of this species raise their offspring together.To find food for them, they must face much larger predators.Baboons are smart, cunning and cause trouble wherever they go.Among them are Umusa and her son.

programs.title: Savage Kingdom
programs.desc: The Savute region, which is located in Botswana, can be both a benevolent paradise and an extremely brutal hell for animals.However, it will always be unpredictable.Covering an area of ​​three thousand square miles, the African savanna is home to competing clans of predators.The survival of lions, leopards, hyenas and wild deer depends on huge herds of their potential prey - buffaloes, elephants and zebras.Every day means a fight for survival, in which the law of nature is the most important.The series has six episodes, thanks to which viewers will be transported to the extraordinary world of animals.There, death can come without warning.Even the most powerful and seemingly invincible kings of the savannah do not know when their last day will come.Viewers will also see how changing weather conditions affect the carnivore clans.During the rainy season, young are born, drought means less food and a dramatic struggle for survival.

programs.title: Giants of The Deep Blue
programs.desc: Oceans cover over seventy percent of the planet's surface.Their waters are roamed by prehistoric sea giants - whales.

programs.title: Kalahari - Africa's Underground Desert
programs.desc: Life in the Kalahari depends on creatures hidden in the sand.Only the smartest and most persistent will survive, those who have found a way to live in extreme temperatures and constant scarcity.

programs.title: America's National Parks
programs.desc: The creators of the series discover the majesty of the most interesting national parks located in the USA.They attract millions of tourists from all over the world.You can admire breathtaking landscapes from popular viewpoints.Viewers will see the beauty of eight national parks from a less obvious perspective.They will move not only to the famous Grand Canyon, but also to less familiar places.They will learn about the guards' favorite places and what makes each of these protected areas so special.They will also see what animals live in these places and what their life is like in the bosom of nature.The latest technologies were used to produce the series, including:drones and cameras with telephoto lenses.

programs.title: Built to Survive
programs.desc: Phil Breslin, a filmmaker and knowledge popularizer from Australia, begins his expedition through the most difficult corners of this continent.During the journey, he talks about animals that managed to master the art of survival.Each episode introduces three species and discusses their unique characteristics.From harsh deserts to seas to forests to rivers, Phil introduces viewers to a variety of ecosystems, showing which animals are best adapted to challenging environmental conditions.
